```{r}
data_raw <- read_excel("mole crabs fixed swash and temp.xlsx") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    water_temp = as.numeric(str_extract(water_temp, "[0-9.]+")),
    date = as.Date(date),
    year = factor(year(date))
  )
```

```{r}
clean_data <- data_raw %>%
  mutate(

    # ===========================
    # STANDARDIZE LOCATION
    # ===========================
    location = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(location), "brighton|bluff") ~ "bluffs",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "south bath|bath ave") ~ "south_bath",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "deal|allenhurst|roosevelt") ~ "deal",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "ocean grove") ~ "ocean_grove",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "sandy hook") ~ "sandy_hook",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN WAVES
    # ===========================
    waves_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "small|\\bsm\\b") ~ "Small",
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "med") ~ "Medium",
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "large|rough|3-5") ~ "Large",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN ZONE
    # ===========================
    zone = tolower(zone),
    zone = case_when(
      str_detect(zone, "bore")  ~ "bore",
      str_detect(zone, "swash|surf") ~ "swash",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN ENVIRONMENTAL NUMERIC VARIABLES
    # ===========================
    salinity = as.numeric(str_extract(salinity, "[0-9.]+")),
    do_mg_l_raw = as.numeric(str_extract(do_mg_l, "[0-9.]+")),
    air_temp_deg_c = as.numeric(str_extract(air_temp_deg_c, "[0-9.]+")),

    # ===========================
    # FIX DO
    # ===========================
    do_mg_l = case_when(
      do_mg_l_raw > 20 ~ NA_real_,
      do_mg_l_raw <= 0 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ do_mg_l_raw
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN MOON PHASE
    # ===========================
    moon_phase_clean = tolower(moon_phase),
    moon_phase_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "full") ~ "Full",
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "first|waxing") ~ "Waxing",
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "last|waning") ~ "Waning",
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "quarter|quater") ~ "Quarter",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN TIDE STAGE
    # ===========================
    tide_clean = tolower(tide_stage),
    tide_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(tide_clean, "high") ~ "High",
      str_detect(tide_clean, "low|\\bl\\b") ~ "Low",
      str_detect(tide_clean, "rising|flood|incoming") ~ "Rising",
      str_detect(tide_clean, "falling|ebb") ~ "Falling",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN SKY
    # ===========================
    sky_clean = tolower(sky),
    sky_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(sky_clean, "clear|sun") ~ "Clear",
      str_detect(sky_clean, "part") ~ "Partly Cloudy",
      str_detect(sky_clean, "cloud") ~ "Cloudy",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN FOAM
    # ===========================
    foam_clean = tolower(foam_floatables_y_n),
    foam_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(foam_clean, "y|foam") ~ "Foam",
      str_detect(foam_clean, "n|none|little") ~ "No Foam",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN WATER CLARITY
    # ===========================
    water_clean = tolower(water_color_transparency),
    water_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(water_clean, "clear|transparent|high transparency") ~ "Clear",
      str_detect(water_clean, "murky|low transparency|dark|brown|grey|cloudy") ~ "Murky",
      str_detect(water_clean, "green|olive|yellow|blue") ~ "Moderate",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%

  # Remove helper column
  dplyr::select(-do_mg_l_raw) %>%

  # Keep valid locations only
  filter(!is.na(location)) %>%

  mutate(
    location = factor(location),
    year = factor(year, levels = sort(unique(year))),
    waves_clean = factor(waves_clean, levels = c("Small","Medium","Large")),
    zone = factor(zone, levels = c("bore","swash")),
    moon_phase_clean = factor(moon_phase_clean,
                              levels = c("Waxing","Full","Waning","Quarter")),
    tide_clean = factor(tide_clean,
                        levels = c("Low","Rising","High","Falling")),
    sky_clean = factor(sky_clean,
                       levels = c("Clear","Partly Cloudy","Cloudy")),
    foam_clean = factor(foam_clean,
                        levels = c("No Foam","Foam")),
    water_clean = factor(water_clean,
                         levels = c("Clear","Moderate","Murky"))
  ) %>%

  droplevels()
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# CREATE LONG FORMAT SIZE DATA
# ----------------------------------

temp_mean <- mean(clean_data$water_temp, na.rm = TRUE)

size_data <- clean_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    date,
    water_temp,
    salinity,
    do_mg_l,
    air_temp_deg_c,
    waves_clean,
    location,
    year,
    zone,
    groin,            
    scoops,
    ct_2mm, ct_6mm, ct_12mm
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    ct_2mm  = as.numeric(ct_2mm),
    ct_6mm  = as.numeric(ct_6mm),
    ct_12mm = as.numeric(ct_12mm),
    
    # Clean  
    groin = case_when(
      groin %in% c("N","n") ~ "North",
      groin %in% c("S","s") ~ "South",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ct_2mm, ct_6mm, ct_12mm),
    names_to = "size_class",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    size_class = factor(
      size_class,
      levels = c("ct_2mm","ct_6mm","ct_12mm"),
      labels = c("Small (2mm)",
                 "Medium (6mm)",
                 "Large (12mm+)")
    ),
    
    water_temp_c = water_temp - temp_mean,
    
    count = ifelse(is.na(count), 0, count),
    
    zone = factor(zone, levels = c("bore","swash")),
    groin = factor(groin, levels = c("North","South"))
  ) %>%
  
  droplevels()
```

```{r}
# ==========================================

size_data <- size_data %>%

      year %in% c("2021","2022") ~ "Baseline",

      year == "2025" ~ "Recovery",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    disturbance_phase = factor(
      disturbance_phase,
      levels = c("Baseline","Transitional","Collapse","Recovery")
    )
  )
# ----------------------------------

    zero_prop = mean(count == 0, na.rm = TRUE),

  mutate(total = ct_2mm + ct_6mm + ct_12mm) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(mean_per_scoop = mean(total, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2024")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year,
              values_from = mean_per_scoop)

    n = n()

print(spatial_summary)

# ----------------------------------
# Dispersion Metrics (NB Justification)
# ----------------------------------

mean_count <- mean(size_data$count, na.rm = TRUE)
var_count  <- var(size_data$count, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Overall mean:", mean_count, "\n")
cat("Overall variance:", var_count, "\n")
cat("Variance-to-Mean ratio:",
    var_count / mean_count, "\n")
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# OBSERVED TEMPORAL TREND
# (CRABS PER SCOOP)
# ==========================================

observed_size <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year, size_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_per_scoop = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(count, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    lower = mean_per_scoop - 1.96 * se,
    upper = mean_per_scoop + 1.96 * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year_num = as.numeric(as.character(year))
  )

ggplot(observed_size,
       aes(x = year_num,
           y = mean_per_scoop,
           color = size_class,
           fill = size_class,
           group = size_class)) +
  
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower,
                  ymax = upper),
              alpha = 0.15,
              color = NA) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.6) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = sort(unique(observed_size$year_num))
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean Abundance (Crabs per Scoop)",
    color = "Size Class",
    fill  = "Size Class",
    title = "Observed Temporal Abundance by Size Class"
  )
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# OBSERVED TEMPERATURE RELATIONSHIP
# (CRABS PER SCOOP)
# ----------------------------------

# ---- Add per-scoop standardization ----
size_data_temp <- size_data %>%
  filter(scoops > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    cps = count / scoops   # crabs per scoop
  )

# ---- Binned summary ----
obs_temp <- size_data_temp %>%
  mutate(temp_bin = round(water_temp * 2) / 2) %>%   # 0.5°C bins
  group_by(size_class, temp_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cps = mean(cps, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(cps, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n >= 5)

ggplot() +
  
  # ---- Raw data points ----
  geom_jitter(
    data = size_data_temp,
    aes(x = water_temp,
        y = pmax(cps, 0.01),
        color = size_class),
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.25,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  
  # ---- SE ribbon ----
  geom_ribbon(
    data = obs_temp,
    aes(x = temp_bin,
        ymin = pmax(mean_cps - se, 0.01),
        ymax = mean_cps + se,
        fill = size_class,
        group = size_class),
    alpha = 0.18,
    color = NA
  ) +
  
  # ---- Mean line ----
  geom_line(
    data = obs_temp,
    aes(x = temp_bin,
        y = mean_cps,
        color = size_class,
        group = size_class),
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  
  # ---- Mean points ----
  geom_point(
    data = obs_temp,
    aes(x = temp_bin,
        y = mean_cps,
        color = size_class),
    size = 3
  ) +
  
  scale_y_log10(
    limits = c(0.05, 150),
    breaks = c(0.1, 1, 10, 100)
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Water Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Mean Abundance (log scale crabs per scoop)",
    color = "Size Class",
    fill  = "Size Class",
    title = "Observed Temperature and Mole Crab Abundance"
  )
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# BIOMASS DECLINE
# ==========================================

# ---- Compute biomass ----
biomass_zone <- size_data %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2022","2023","2024","2025"),
         zone %in% c("bore","swash")) %>%
  mutate(
    size_mm = case_when(
      size_class == "Small (2mm)" ~ 2,
      size_class == "Medium (6mm)" ~ 6,
      size_class == "Large (12mm+)" ~ 12
    ),
    biomass_proxy = count * size_mm
  ) %>%
  group_by(zone, year) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_biomass = mean(biomass_proxy, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(biomass_proxy, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    lower = mean_biomass - 1.96 * se,
    upper = mean_biomass + 1.96 * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(year_num = as.numeric(as.character(year)))

# ---- Calculate recovery metrics ----
metrics <- biomass_zone %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2024","2025")) %>%
  dplyr::select(zone, year, mean_biomass) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year,
              values_from = mean_biomass)

# Collapse (should be nearly identical across zones)
collapse_pct <- round(
  mean((1 - metrics$`2024` / metrics$`2021`) * 100),
  0
)

# Zone-specific net recovery
metrics <- metrics %>%
  mutate(
    Net_Recovery = round((`2025` / `2021`) * 100, 0)
  )

swash_recovery <- metrics$Net_Recovery[metrics$zone == "swash"]
bore_recovery  <- metrics$Net_Recovery[metrics$zone == "bore"]

# ---- Disturbance Band ----
disturbance <- data.frame(
  xmin = 2023,
  xmax = 2024,
  ymin = min(biomass_zone$lower),
  ymax = max(biomass_zone$upper)
)

# ---- Plot ----
ggplot(biomass_zone,
       aes(x = year_num,
           y = mean_biomass,
           color = zone,
           fill = zone,
           group = zone)) +

  geom_rect(data = disturbance,
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(xmin = xmin,
                xmax = xmax,
                ymin = ymin,
                ymax = ymax),
            fill = "red",
            alpha = 0.07) +

  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower,
                  ymax = upper),
              alpha = 0.18,
              color = NA) +

  geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +

  # ---- Dynamic Annotations ----
  annotate("text",
           x = 2023.5,
           y = max(biomass_zone$upper) * 0.5,
           label = paste0("Beach Nourishment\n~",
                          collapse_pct, "% Collapse from baseline"),
           color = "red",
           fontface = "bold",
           size = 5,
           hjust = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("bore" = "darkgreen",
                                "swash" = "limegreen")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("bore" = "darkgreen",
                               "swash" = "limegreen")) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2021,2022,2023,2024,2025)) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean Biomass (mm × count)",
    color = "Zone",
    fill = "Zone",
    title = "Zone-Specific Biomass Collapse and Divergent Recovery",
    subtitle = "Baseline biomass estimated at 2021-2022"
  )
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# DEMOGRAPHIC RESET – STATISTICAL TESTS
# ==========================================

# ----------------------------------
# Build contingency matrix
# ----------------------------------

structure_table <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year, size_class) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = size_class,
              values_from = total,
              values_fill = 0)

mat <- as.matrix(structure_table[,-1])
rownames(mat) <- structure_table$year

years <- rownames(mat)

# ----------------------------------
# Run all pairwise comparisons
# ----------------------------------

results_list <- list()
counter <- 1

for (i in 1:(length(years)-1)) {
  for (j in (i+1):length(years)) {
    
    y1 <- years[i]
    y2 <- years[j]
    
    sub_mat <- mat[c(y1, y2), ]
    
    chi <- chisq.test(sub_mat)
    
    X2 <- chi$statistic
    N  <- sum(sub_mat)
    k  <- min(nrow(sub_mat)-1, ncol(sub_mat)-1)
    V  <- sqrt(X2 / (N * k))
    
    results_list[[counter]] <- data.frame(
      Year_1 = y1,
      Year_2 = y2,
      Chi_sq = as.numeric(X2),
      df = chi$parameter,
      p_value = chi$p.value,
      Cramers_V = as.numeric(V)
    )
    
    counter <- counter + 1
  }
}

pairwise_results <- bind_rows(results_list)

# ----------------------------------
# Multiple comparison correction
# ----------------------------------

pairwise_results$p_adj_FDR <-
  p.adjust(pairwise_results$p_value,
           method = "fdr")

# ----------------------------------
# Sort by strongest structural shift
# ----------------------------------

pairwise_results <- pairwise_results %>%
  arrange(desc(Cramers_V))

print(pairwise_results)
```

```{r}
analysis_data <- size_data %>%
  
  # Exclude control/outside site
  filter(location != "sandy_hook") %>%
  
  # Remove zero effort
  filter(scoops > 0) %>%
  
  mutate(
    # Log sampling effort
    log_scoops = log(scoops),
    
    # Center date
    date_numeric = as.numeric(date),
    date_c = date_numeric - mean(date_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Center environmental predictors
    salinity_c = salinity - mean(salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    do_c = do_mg_l - mean(do_mg_l, na.rm = TRUE),
    air_temp_c = air_temp_deg_c - mean(air_temp_deg_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # ---- Collapse 2021–2022 to Baseline ----
    year = case_when(
      year %in% c("2021","2022") ~ "Baseline",
      TRUE ~ as.character(year)
    ),
    
    year = factor(year,
                  levels = c("Baseline",
                             "2023",
                             "2024",
                             "2025")),
    
    zone = factor(zone, levels = c("bore","swash")),
    groin = factor(groin, levels = c("North","South"))
  ) %>%
  
  drop_na(count, scoops, size_class, location, year) %>%
  droplevels()

# Set reference levels
analysis_data$location <- relevel(analysis_data$location,
                                  ref = "south_bath")

analysis_data$year <- relevel(analysis_data$year,
                              ref = "Baseline")
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# ZONE-SPECIFIC NEGATIVE BINOMIAL MODELS
# Swash vs Bore Comparison
# ==========================================

# ----------------------------------
# Create Zone-Specific Datasets
# ----------------------------------

analysis_swash <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(zone == "swash",
         location != "sandy_hook",
         scoops > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    log_scoops = log(scoops),
    salinity_c = salinity - mean(salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    do_c = do_mg_l - mean(do_mg_l, na.rm = TRUE),
    air_temp_c = air_temp_deg_c - mean(air_temp_deg_c, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  drop_na(count, size_class, location, year) %>%
  droplevels()

analysis_bore <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(zone == "bore",
         location != "sandy_hook",
         scoops > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    log_scoops = log(scoops),
    salinity_c = salinity - mean(salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    do_c = do_mg_l - mean(do_mg_l, na.rm = TRUE),
    air_temp_c = air_temp_deg_c - mean(air_temp_deg_c, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  drop_na(count, size_class, location, year) %>%
  droplevels()

# Set consistent reference levels
analysis_swash$year <- relevel(analysis_swash$year, ref = "Baseline")
analysis_bore$year  <- relevel(analysis_bore$year,  ref = "Baseline")
analysis_swash$location <- relevel(analysis_swash$location, ref = "south_bath")
analysis_bore$location  <- relevel(analysis_bore$location,  ref = "south_bath")

# ----------------------------------
# Fit Identical Models
# ----------------------------------

nb_swash <- glm.nb(
  count ~ log_scoops +
          water_temp_c * size_class +
          location * year,
  data = analysis_swash,
  control = glm.control(maxit = 200)
)

nb_bore <- glm.nb(
  count ~ log_scoops +
          water_temp_c * size_class +
          location * year,
  data = analysis_bore,
  control = glm.control(maxit = 200)
)
# ==========================================
# EXTRACT IRRs FOR ALL YEARS
# Swash vs Bore Comparison
# ==========================================

extract_year_irrs <- function(model, zone_name) {
  
  coef_summary <- summary(model)$coefficients
  
  # Grab only year terms
  year_rows <- grep("^year", rownames(coef_summary), value = TRUE)
  
  irr_list <- lapply(year_rows, function(term) {
    
    beta <- coef_summary[term, "Estimate"]
    se   <- coef_summary[term, "Std. Error"]
    
    IRR <- exp(beta)
    LWR <- exp(beta - 1.96 * se)
    UPR <- exp(beta + 1.96 * se)
    
    data.frame(
      Zone = zone_name,
      Year = gsub("year", "", term),
      IRR = IRR,
      Lower_95CI = LWR,
      Upper_95CI = UPR,
      Percent_Change = (1 - IRR) * 100
    )
  })
  
  do.call(rbind, irr_list)
}

# Extract for both models
irr_swash_all <- extract_year_irrs(nb_swash, "Swash")
irr_bore_all  <- extract_year_irrs(nb_bore,  "Bore")

# Combine
zone_year_comparison <- bind_rows(irr_swash_all,
                                  irr_bore_all)

# Clean row names
rownames(zone_year_comparison) <- NULL

print(zone_year_comparison)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# FORMAL TEST: ZONE × YEAR INTERACTION
# Likelihood Ratio Test (LRT)
# ==========================================

# ----------------------------------
# Fit Model WITHOUT interaction
# (Assumes same temporal trend in both zones)
# ----------------------------------

nb_no_interaction <- glm.nb(
  count ~ log_scoops +
          water_temp_c * size_class +
          location +
          zone +
          year,
  data = analysis_data,
  control = glm.control(maxit = 200)
)

# ----------------------------------
# Fit Model WITH interaction
# (Allows temporal trends to differ by zone)
# ----------------------------------

nb_with_interaction <- glm.nb(
  count ~ log_scoops +
          water_temp_c * size_class +
          location +
          zone * year,
  data = analysis_data,
  control = glm.control(maxit = 200)
)

# ----------------------------------
# Likelihood Ratio Test
# ----------------------------------

lrt_result <- anova(nb_no_interaction,
                    nb_with_interaction,
                    test = "LRT")

print(lrt_result)

# ----------------------------------
# Zone × Year IRRs From Interaction Model
# ----------------------------------

coefs <- coef(nb_with_interaction)
vc    <- vcov(nb_with_interaction)

years_to_extract <- c("2023","2024","2025")

zone_year_irr <- lapply(years_to_extract, function(yr) {
  
  year_term  <- paste0("year", yr)
  inter_term <- paste0("zoneswash:year", yr)
  
  # -------------------------
  # Bore (reference zone)
  # -------------------------
  
  beta_bore <- coefs[year_term]
  var_bore  <- vc[year_term, year_term]
  se_bore   <- sqrt(var_bore)
  
  irr_bore  <- exp(beta_bore)
  lwr_bore  <- exp(beta_bore - 1.96 * se_bore)
  upr_bore  <- exp(beta_bore + 1.96 * se_bore)
  
  # -------------------------
  # Swash
  # -------------------------
  
  beta_swash <- coefs[year_term] + coefs[inter_term]
  
  var_swash <- vc[year_term, year_term] +
               vc[inter_term, inter_term] +
               2 * vc[year_term, inter_term]
  
  se_swash <- sqrt(var_swash)
  
  irr_swash <- exp(beta_swash)
  lwr_swash <- exp(beta_swash - 1.96 * se_swash)
  upr_swash <- exp(beta_swash + 1.96 * se_swash)
  
  rbind(
    data.frame(
      Zone = "Bore",
      Year = yr,
      IRR = irr_bore,
      Lower_95CI = lwr_bore,
      Upper_95CI = upr_bore,
      Percent_Change = (1 - irr_bore) * 100
    ),
    data.frame(
      Zone = "Swash",
      Year = yr,
      IRR = irr_swash,
      Lower_95CI = lwr_swash,
      Upper_95CI = upr_swash,
      Percent_Change = (1 - irr_swash) * 100
    )
  )
})

zone_year_irr <- do.call(rbind, zone_year_irr)
rownames(zone_year_irr) <- NULL
print(zone_year_irr)
summary(nb_with_interaction)$coefficients[
  grep("year2022|zoneswash:year2022",
       rownames(summary(nb_with_interaction)$coefficients)), ]
summary(nb_with_interaction)$coefficients[
  grep("zoneswash:year2025",
       rownames(summary(nb_with_interaction)$coefficients)), ]
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
```
```{r}
# SIZE-SPECIFIC TEMPERATURE EFFECTS
# ==========================================

coefs <- coef(nb_final)
vc    <- vcov(nb_final)

sizes <- levels(analysis_data$size_class)

temp_effects <- lapply(sizes, function(s) {

  beta <- coefs["water_temp_c"]
  var  <- vc["water_temp_c", "water_temp_c"]

  interaction_term <- paste0("water_temp_c:size_class", s)

  if (interaction_term %in% names(coefs)) {
    beta <- beta + coefs[interaction_term]
    var  <- var +
      vc[interaction_term, interaction_term] +
      2 * vc["water_temp_c", interaction_term]
  }

  se <- sqrt(var)

  IRR  <- exp(beta)
  LWR  <- exp(beta - 1.96 * se)
  UPR  <- exp(beta + 1.96 * se)

  data.frame(
    Size_Class = s,
    IRR_per_1C = IRR,
    Lower_95CI = LWR,
    Upper_95CI = UPR,
    Percent_Change = (1 - IRR) * 100
  )
})

temp_effects <- do.call(rbind, temp_effects)

#Remove inherited row names
rownames(temp_effects) <- NULL

print(temp_effects, digits = 3)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# PHASE-SPECIFIC TEMPERATURE FILTERING TEST
# ==========================================

# ----------------------------------
# 1. Create Phase Variable
# ----------------------------------

analysis_data$phase <- ifelse(
  analysis_data$year == "Baseline", "Baseline",
  ifelse(analysis_data$year == "2025", "Recovery", "Disturbance")
)

analysis_data$phase <- factor(
  analysis_data$phase,
  levels = c("Baseline","Disturbance","Recovery")
)

# ----------------------------------
# 2. Fit Models
# ----------------------------------

# Base model (no phase moderation)
nb_base_temp <- glm.nb(
  count ~ log_scoops +
          water_temp_c * size_class +
          zone * year +
          location,
  data = analysis_data,
  control = glm.control(maxit = 200)
)

# Phase-moderated model
nb_phase_temp <- glm.nb(
  count ~ log_scoops +
          water_temp_c * size_class * phase +
          zone * year +
          location,
  data = analysis_data,
  control = glm.control(maxit = 200)
)

# ----------------------------------
# 3. Model Comparison
# ----------------------------------

lrt_phase <- anova(nb_base_temp, nb_phase_temp, test = "LRT")
print(lrt_phase)

aic_phase <- AIC(nb_base_temp, nb_phase_temp)
print(aic_phase)

cat("\nDelta AIC:",
    round(diff(aic_phase$AIC), 3), "\n")

# ==========================================
# 4. CLEAN TEMPERATURE SLOPE SUMMARY TABLE
# (IRR per 1°C by Size × Phase)
# ==========================================

coefs <- coef(nb_phase_temp)
vc    <- vcov(nb_phase_temp)

sizes  <- levels(analysis_data$size_class)
phases <- levels(analysis_data$phase)

temp_summary <- list()
counter <- 1

for (p in phases) {
  for (s in sizes) {
    
    # Base temperature term
    beta <- coefs["water_temp_c"]
    var  <- vc["water_temp_c", "water_temp_c"]
    
    # Size interaction
    size_term <- paste0("water_temp_c:size_class", s)
    if (size_term %in% names(coefs)) {
      beta <- beta + coefs[size_term]
      var  <- var +
        vc[size_term, size_term] +
        2 * vc["water_temp_c", size_term]
    }
    
    # Phase interaction
    phase_term <- paste0("water_temp_c:phase", p)
    if (phase_term %in% names(coefs)) {
      beta <- beta + coefs[phase_term]
      var  <- var +
        vc[phase_term, phase_term] +
        2 * vc["water_temp_c", phase_term]
    }
    
    # Size × Phase interaction
    sp_term <- paste0("water_temp_c:size_class", s, ":phase", p)
    if (sp_term %in% names(coefs)) {
      beta <- beta + coefs[sp_term]
      var  <- var +
        vc[sp_term, sp_term] +
        2 * vc["water_temp_c", sp_term]
    }
    
    se <- sqrt(var)
    
    IRR  <- exp(beta)
    LWR  <- exp(beta - 1.96 * se)
    UPR  <- exp(beta + 1.96 * se)
    
    temp_summary[[counter]] <- data.frame(
      Phase = p,
      Size_Class = s,
      Beta = beta,
      IRR_per_1C = IRR,
      Lower_95CI = LWR,
      Upper_95CI = UPR,
      Percent_Change = (1 - IRR) * 100
    )
    
    counter <- counter + 1
  }
}

temp_summary <- bind_rows(temp_summary)

# Clean formatting
temp_summary$Percent_Change <-
  round(temp_summary$Percent_Change, 1)

temp_summary$IRR_per_1C <-
  round(temp_summary$IRR_per_1C, 3)

temp_summary$Lower_95CI <-
  round(temp_summary$Lower_95CI, 3)

temp_summary$Upper_95CI <-
  round(temp_summary$Upper_95CI, 3)

print(temp_summary)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================

coef_summary <- summary(nb_final)$coefficients

# Extract only year coefficients

)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# DENSITY DEPENDENCE TEST
# Adult Bore Preference vs Adult Abundance
# ==========================================

# ---- Function: Adult Partition Strength ----
compute_adult_partition <- function(data_subset) {
  
  tab <- data_subset %>%
    mutate(group = ifelse(size_class=="Large (12mm+)",
                          "Adult","NonAdult")) %>%
    group_by(zone, group) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(count), .groups="drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from=group,
                values_from=total,
                values_fill=0)
  
  if (nrow(tab) < 2 || ncol(tab) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  
  mat <- as.matrix(tab[,-1])
  rownames(mat) <- tab$zone
  
  chi <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(mat))
  
  N <- sum(mat)
  k <- min(nrow(mat)-1, ncol(mat)-1)
  
  sqrt(as.numeric(chi$statistic) / (N * k))
}

# ---- Adult abundance by year ----
adult_abundance_year <- size_data %>%
  filter(size_class=="Large (12mm+)") %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(total_adults = sum(count),
            .groups="drop")

# ---- Adult partition strength by year ----
adult_partition_year <- size_data %>%
  group_split(year) %>%
  lapply(function(df) {
    data.frame(
      year = unique(df$year),
      V_adult = compute_adult_partition(df)
    )
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

# ---- Combine ----
adult_density_df <- left_join(
  adult_partition_year,
  adult_abundance_year,
  by="year"
)

print(adult_density_df)

# ---- Linear Density Dependence Test ----
lm_linear <- lm(V_adult ~ total_adults,
                data=adult_density_df)

cat("\n--- Linear Model ---\n")
print(summary(lm_linear))

# ---- Quadratic Test (Threshold possibility) ----
lm_quad <- lm(V_adult ~ total_adults +
                         I(total_adults^2),
              data=adult_density_df)

cat("\n--- Quadratic Model ---\n")
print(summary(lm_quad))
```

```{r}
# ==========================================================
# SYSTEM DESTABILIZATION METRICS (Narrative-Focused)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Early Warning Signal: Variance & Coefficient of Variation
# ----------------------------------------------------------

variance_year <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_count = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_count   = sd(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    CV         = sd_count / mean_count,
    .groups="drop"
  )

cat("\n=== Variance & CV by Year ===\n")
print(variance_year)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Adult Structural Partition Strength Over Time
# (Loss of Density Regulation)
# ----------------------------------------------------------

compute_adult_partition <- function(data_subset) {
  
  tab <- data_subset %>%
    mutate(group = ifelse(size_class=="Large (12mm+)",
                          "Adult","Other")) %>%
    group_by(zone, group) %>%
    summarise(total=sum(count), .groups="drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from=group,
                values_from=total,
                values_fill=0)
  
  if(nrow(tab) < 2 || ncol(tab) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  
  mat <- as.matrix(tab[,-1])
  rownames(mat) <- tab$zone
  
  chi <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(mat))
  N <- sum(mat)
  k <- min(nrow(mat)-1, ncol(mat)-1)
  
  sqrt(as.numeric(chi$statistic)/(N*k))
}

partition_time <- size_data %>%
  group_split(year) %>%
  lapply(function(df){
    data.frame(
      year = unique(df$year),
      V_adult = compute_adult_partition(df)
    )
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

cat("\n=== Adult Partition Strength (Cramer's V) ===\n")
print(partition_time)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Demographic Evenness (Shannon Diversity)
# ----------------------------------------------------------

shannon_year <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year, size_class) %>%
  summarise(total=sum(count), .groups="drop") %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(prop = total/sum(total)) %>%
  summarise(
    Shannon_H = -sum(prop*log(prop)),
    .groups="drop"
  )

cat("\n=== Shannon Diversity by Year ===\n")
print(shannon_year)

  mutate(
    size_mm = case_when(
      size_class=="Small (2mm)"~2,
      size_class=="Medium (6mm)"~6,
      size_class=="Large (12mm+)"~12
    ),
    biomass = count*size_mm
  ) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(mean_biomass = mean(biomass), .groups="drop")

recovery_rate <- biomass_year %>%
```

```{r disturbance_clock, eval=knitr::is_html_output()}
  pull(mean_V)

adult_part_2023 <- partition_time %>%
  filter(year == "2023") %>%
  pull(V_adult)

adult_part_baseline <- round(adult_part_baseline, 2)
adult_part_2023     <- round(adult_part_2023, 2)

# ---- Shannon Collapse ----
shannon_baseline <- shannon_year %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2022")) %>%
  summarise(mean_H = mean(Shannon_H)) %>%
  pull(mean_H)

shannon_2023 <- shannon_year %>%
  filter(year == "2023") %>%
  pull(Shannon_H)

shannon_baseline <- round(shannon_baseline, 2)
shannon_2023     <- round(shannon_2023, 2)

# ---- Biomass Recovery Multiplier ----
biomass_2024 <- biomass_year %>%
  filter(year == "2024") %>%
  pull(mean_biomass)

biomass_2025 <- biomass_year %>%
  filter(year == "2025") %>%
  pull(mean_biomass)

biomass_rebound <- round(biomass_2025 / biomass_2024, 2)

# =========================================
# LABEL STRINGS
# =========================================

disturb_label <- 
  "<B>Beach Nourishment 2019-2020</B><BR/>Pre-study disturbance"

stable_label <- paste0(
  "<B>Stable State 2021-2022</B><BR/>",
  "Pooled baseline<BR/>",
  "n = ", sample_n
)
baseline_partition_label <- paste0(
  "<B>Ontogenetic Partitioning</B><BR/>",
  "Juveniles prefer swash", "<BR/>", "Adults prefer bore<BR/>",
  "Chi-square = ", chi_base_val, "<BR/>",
  "p &lt; 0.005"
)
zero_label <- paste0(
  "<B>Beach Nourishment Disturbance 2023-2024</B><BR/>",
  zero_or, "× higher zero crab count likelihood<BR/>",
  "CV: ", cv_baseline, " → ", cv_disturb,
  " (Δ = +", round(cv_disturb - cv_baseline, 2), ")"
)
temp_label <- paste0(
  "<B>Size-Class Temperature Filtering</B><BR/>",
  "Small = ", temp_text(small_temp), " per 1°C<BR/>",
  "Medium = ", temp_text(medium_temp), " per 1°C<BR/>",
  "Large = ", temp_text(large_temp), " per 1°C"
)

break_label <- paste0(
  "<B>Structural Break 2023</B><BR/>",
  "Cramers V = ", V_max , "<BR/>",
  "Adult partition: ", adult_part_baseline,
  " → ", adult_part_2023, "<BR/>",
  "Shannon H: ", shannon_baseline,
  " → ", shannon_2023
)

collapse_label <- paste0(
  "<B>Collapse 2024</B><BR/>",
  irr_2024, "% abundance decline (IRR = ", irr_val, ")<BR/>",
  collapse_pct, "% biomass reduction"
)
interaction_label <- paste0(
  "<B>Zone and Year Interaction</B><BR/>",
  "Chi-square = ", lrt_chi, "<BR/>",
  "p &lt; 0.005"
)

swash_label <- paste0(
  "<B>Swash Recovery 2025</B><BR/>",
  swash_recovery, "% biomass of baseline<BR/>",
  "Chi-square = ", chi_swash_val, "<BR/>",
  "p &lt; 0.005<BR/>"
)

bore_label <- paste0(
  "<B>Bore Suppression 2025</B><BR/>",
  bore_recovery, "% biomass of baseline","<BR/>",
  "Chi-square = ", chi_bore_val, "<BR/>",
  "p &lt; 0.005<BR/>"
)
next_label <- paste0(
  "<B>Next Nourishment 2026-2027</B>"
)
recruit_label <- paste0(
  "<B>Recruitment Pulse 2025</B><BR/>",
  "Biomass rebound: ", biomass_rebound, "×","<BR/>",
  "Mean size: ", mean_size_2021, 
  " → ", mean_size_2025, " mm<BR/>",
  "Juvenile proportion: ",
  baseline_small_prop, "% → ",
  recovery_small_prop, "%<BR/>"
)
adult_density_label <- paste0(
  "<B>Adult Density Dependence</B><BR/>",
  "Bore separation strength increases <BR/>with adult abundance<BR/>", "R² = ", round(summary(lm_linear)$r.squared, 2), "<BR/>","p &lt; 0.005"
)
# =========================================
# FLOWCHART
# =========================================

dot_code <- paste0(
"digraph nourishment_structure {

graph [layout = dot, rankdir = TB]

node [
  shape = box,
  style = \"rounded,filled\",
  fontname = Helvetica,
  fontsize = 20,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 2.6,
  penwidth = 2
]

Disturb2019 [label=<", disturb_label, ">, fillcolor=\"#FFB347\"]
StableState [label=<", stable_label, ">, fillcolor=\"gold\"]
ZeroSpike [label=<", zero_label, ">, fillcolor=\"#FFB347\"]
TempFiltering [label=<", temp_label, ">, fillcolor=\"steelblue1\"]
Break2023 [label=<", break_label, ">, fillcolor=\"mediumpurple1\"]
Collapse2024 [label=<", collapse_label, ">, fillcolor=\"lightcoral\"]
Interaction [label=<", interaction_label, ">, fillcolor=\"#4DB6AC\"]
Swash2025 [label=<", swash_label, ">, fillcolor=\"limegreen\"]
Bore2025 [label=<", bore_label, ">, fillcolor=\"paleturquoise2\"]
NextEvent [label=<", next_label, ">, fillcolor=\"#FFB347\"]
Recruit2025 [label=<", recruit_label, ">, fillcolor=\"turquoise\"]
Partition [label=<", baseline_partition_label, ">, fillcolor=\"violet\"]
AdultDensity [label=<", adult_density_label, ">, fillcolor=\"yellowgreen\"]

{ rank = same; Partition; StableState; AdultDensity; }
Partition -> StableState [style=invis, weight=100]

)
grViz(dot_code)
```
